claims.interpretation: highD factual and structural intervention evidence only

highd_adapted_realism.definition: fixed-bin highD distribution diagnostics inspired by the WOSAC kinematic/interactive components; not an official WOSAC score

evaluation_protocol.factual_reconstruction: held-out C0 and held-out long-horizon condition with a frozen diffusion preview; this is conditional reconstruction, not unconditional scenario-generation accuracy
evaluation_protocol.jerk_protocol: raw 0.04 s action jerk is reported together with 0.2 s windowed jerk because highD raw jerk has a large quantized zero mass

limitations: Within a fixed K constraint, motion diversity must be interpreted together with its proper score.
Raw 0.04 s jerk KS is dominated by highD's quantized zero mass; the 0.2 s windowed diagnostic is more representative of continuous motion but does not replace the raw metric.
Observed highD data and structural intervention tests do not prove counterfactual correctness for arbitrary ADS policies.

model_contract.architecture: Flow p(M)p(C0|M)p(K|C0,M); diffusion (C0,M,K) -> soft plan; observation-filtered, two-time-scale HiQR jerk response
model_contract.evt_role: external human-risk scale; excluded from training loss
model_contract.soft_plan_policy: rebase plan increments to the realized state

randomness_contract.z_motion: one motion seed deterministically addresses epsilon_diff [149,6,2], the 16-D scene innovation and six 16-D agent innovations
randomness_contract.z_scenario: Flow base randomness (u_M,z_C0,z_K); with fixed C0/M only z_K varies
